notes.title: New Features and Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's ohkapi.

This update is packed with exciting new features, challenging achievements, and helpful improvements. Let's take a look:

[b]New Features[/b]
[*]Cinema Gallery
The Cinema Gallery is now here!  Rewatch all the videos you've unlocked in one convenient place. Easily revisit your favorite scenes or catch anything you might have missed. [i]Note: You need to complete the game once to unlock the Cinema Gallery.[/i]
[*]Puzzle Mode
A challenging new Puzzle Mode has been added for all you dating gurus!  This mode, originally designed for the game's launch, will test your skills as you decipher clues from your matches' conversations to earn points and climb the ranks to Gold Tier.


[b]New Achievements - 3 to Conquer![/b]
[*]RMT-Free Victory
"No cash, no cheats—just pure skill. Shouting for love without spending a cent."
[*]Master of Puzzle
"Trickier than playing hard to get, cracked the puzzle mode and became a true dating master."
[*]One Last Zombie Falls
"The final bullet—not for revenge, not for farewell, but for our love, eternal and undying."

Improved "Revert Time map"
Added key prompt for "Revert Point" on dating app failures

Updated achievement icons
Adjusted character meeting requirements for achievements

Updated videos

Polished text and subtitles

Various bug fixes

 This update is a true collaboration with the Steam Community, as it's directly based on the valuable feedback I've received. I'm so grateful for your insights and ideas, which are essential to making this game the best it can be. Thank you so much for your support and for playing! 😊

notes.title: Live Streaming & Video Upload Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248035/8f6c9ba17ad3b4e34f77b6445bdd027b3eac5f0a.png[/img]

[h1]'Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App'
Streaming & Video Upload Policy[/h1]

✔ Live Streaming Allowed
Players are permitted to stream live gameplay on personal broadcasting platforms such as Twitch, YouTube Live, CHZZK, and others.

✔ Edited Gameplay Videos Allowed
Players may record and edit their gameplay footage for upload on video-sharing platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, and Twitter.

✖ No Videos Focusing on Specific Characters
Uploading videos that solely compile scenes of specific characters is not allowed.
The charm of this game lies in the intricate interplay of various characters and the overarching storyline. Isolating specific characters in video compilations reduces the depth of the narrative and diminishes the intended experience of the game.

Moreover, widespread distribution of such content may weaken other players’ motivation to experience the game firsthand, ultimately affecting game sales and development sustainability. We kindly ask for your cooperation in ensuring that the carefully crafted stories and characters are not reduced to mere clips.

✖ No Malicious Edits or Misrepresentation
Editing content in a way that misrepresents or distorts the game’s narrative or characters is strictly prohibited.
Deliberately cutting scenes out of context to create misleading impressions is not allowed.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

His days are stuck in a routine, just going between work and home.
Time’s ticking, and with every year, his chances of dating seem to fade… and he doesn’t even have a friend to set him up on a blind date.

He has no idea how to start a conversation or what to say.

On dating apps, he’s got to win someone over fast, but with his skills, he’s falling short.

From smooth flirting, picking the right topics, making choices in awkward moments, to pulling off that perfect charm...
Can he follow your advice and level up?
Your choices could either help him survive the dating jungle or send him crashing and burning.
